name: Button
blurb: The main action control, in six variants and four sizes.
mechanism: Static markup on a real `<button>`. Every variant is a class swap, and the loading state is a class the button carries - nothing about it is stateful.
caveats: Icon-only buttons must carry aria-label — there is no text to announce.
A disabled button is not focusable, so its tooltip or reason must live elsewhere in the DOM.
